string.text:
Tools and oils for maintaining weapons. 
 
Minimum condition for repair: 50%

Sewing tools for maintaining armor and helmets. 
 
Minimum condition for repair: 50%

%c[255,170,220,255]Repair kits%c[default] 
Weapon and sewing repair kits have two uses each. The weapon kit repairs weapons, and the sewing kit repairs armor and helmets. Use RMB to choose suitable gear from the inventory or drag the kit onto the desired item. 

%c[255,120,210,120]Effect: up to +20 percentage points of condition per use.%c[default] 
A kit works at 50% condition or higher, but below 100%. Repairs can fully restore an item without exceeding 100% condition. The kit description shows the number of uses remaining. 

%c[255,255,190,90]Metal part%c[default] 
It works only on a weapon displaying 90–99% condition. It adds 2 percentage points, up to a maximum of 100%, and is consumed after the repair.
